Description

Apple MacBook Air 13.6" - M5 chip-10-core CPU-10-core GPU-24GB Ram-1TB SSD

The Apple MacBook Air 13.6-inch M5 – 10-Core CPU, 10-Core GPU, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD delivers powerful multitasking and creative performance in a slim, lightweight aluminium design.

It features a vibrant Liquid Retina display, Apple Intelligence, Wi-Fi 7 and up to 18 hours of video-streaming battery life.

The Apple MacBook Air 13.6-inch M5 – 10-Core CPU, 10-Core GPU, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD is designed for professionals, students and content creators who need strong performance and generous storage in an ultraportable laptop.

The Apple M5 chip combines a 10-core CPU with four super cores and six efficiency cores, a 10-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, hardware-accelerated ray tracing and a 16-core Neural Engine. Its 153GB/s memory bandwidth and 24GB of unified memory provide responsive performance for demanding multitasking, productivity, media creation and supported AI workflows.

Its 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display delivers a 2560 × 1664 resolution, 500-nit brightness, P3 wide colour, True Tone technology and support for one billion colours. The 12MP Center Stage camera, three-microphone array and four-speaker sound system support clear video calls and immersive entertainment.

The 1TB SSD provides spacious, fast storage for applications, documents, creative projects and media libraries. Connectivity includes MagSafe 3, two Thunderbolt 4 USB-C ports, a 3.5mm headphone jack, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread networking technology.

The MacBook Air supports up to two external displays while keeping its built-in display active. Its 53.8Wh battery provides up to 18 hours of video streaming or up to 15 hours of wireless web use, with fast charging supported using a compatible 70W or higher USB Power Delivery source.
